stop_reason: No exercise contrast identifiable. The only grouping factor is age (Young/Older), and the paper matched the groups on physical activity (S2.2.p1, S1.p3), so Older vs Young estimates ageing, not exercise. The paper's physical-activity analysis (expression vs continuous MVPA, S3.4.p4) needs per-subject accelerometry MVPA, which GSE159217 metadata does not contain (only title, sex, tissue, age group); it is not in the paper's supplement either. An exercise effect therefore cannot be estimated from the deposited data.
